verdict.rationale: The evidence documents ring groups that let several people answer calls to one shared Google Voice number and place outbound calls from it. Nothing shows inbound texts to a business number landing in a shared team inbox or recording which teammate replied. Call-sharing is an adjacent feature and does not count toward a shared SMS inbox, and community mentions of individual texting do not address team inboxes.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied
